status: Exploratory approximation, not a rigorous certificate
training_cost_policy: An independently constructed Atlas is charged in full to every family and degree; no cross-family response sharing or free offline training
baseline: Network reuse plus sparse Newton with adjacent-control/investment and prior-profile residual-selected warm starts, tolerance 1e-10
main_reuse: One main-grid ACSystem for each T level in each profile; all X/F/tap/cap combinations preserve their discrete feeder response label
timing_scope: Training plus online state enumeration including assembly, warm-start selection, solves and physical metrics. File I/O, reference comparisons and common post-processing of investment menus are outside the comparative timing.
